newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks close softer but resist sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks close softer but resist sell-off.

text.p: * Toronto's key stock index ended softer in active dealings but resisted the Wall St sell-off late in the day. * Kept in check by stronger banks
Toronto's stock market ended softer on Thursday but managed to avoid the massive sell-off on Wall Street as heavily weighted bank and transport equities remained strong, analysts said.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index slipped 18.16 points to end at 6040.51 while the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 94.28 points to 6755.75 in late trading.
A trader said: "This is mostly a Dow-blue chip sell-off."
The strength of the important financial services sector and transportation stocks kept Toronto from tumbling.
